name: url-shortener-api
description: URL shortener API on AWS Lambda, API Gateway HTTP API and DynamoDB, built with lesgo

scripts.test:template: npm run package:custom-domain && npm run package && jest -c jest.template.config.js
scripts.package: env -u AWS_PROFILE -u APP_DEBUG -u SHORT_URL_DOMAIN -u BYPASS_URL_EXISTS_DOMAINS AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=local AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=local AWS_REGION=us-east-1 AWS_APP_REGION=us-east-1 AWS_APIGW_DISABLE_DEFAULT_ENDPOINT=false osls package --stage local
scripts.package:custom-domain: env -u AWS_PROFILE -u APP_DEBUG -u SHORT_URL_DOMAIN -u BYPASS_URL_EXISTS_DOMAINS AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=local AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=local AWS_REGION=us-east-1 AWS_APP_REGION=us-east-1 AWS_APIGW_DISABLE_DEFAULT_ENDPOINT=true osls package --stage local --package .serverless-custom-domain
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run package
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run openapi:lint && npm run test:template
scripts.start: env -u AWS_PROFILE AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=local AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=local AWS_REGION=us-east-1 AWS_APP_REGION=us-east-1 AWS_APIGW_DISABLE_DEFAULT_ENDPOINT=false AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_DYNAMODB=http://127.0.0.1:${DYNAMODB_LOCAL_PORT:-18000} osls offline start --stage local
